svg.title: Fourier modes under heat flow
svg.desc: Exact periodic heat-equation solution u(x,t)=e^(−t)sin(x)+0.45e^(−9t)sin(3x)+0.25e^(−25t)cos(5x), for 0≤x≤2π and 0≤t≤1. Gold is the initial profile; purple profiles show faster decay of the higher-frequency modes. The height is u, and receding direction is time.
svg.title: Fourier modes under heat flow
